name: AMS Luna-2
about: AMS Luna-2 (1959 XI 1, OKB1), launched 1959 Sep 12. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
GCAT gives a straight-in path to the ground, periapsis below the surface
